overview.description: The VanEck Morningstar Wide Moat Value ETF (MVAL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund tracks a modified equal-weighted index of 30 to 60 value-oriented US stocks that Morningstar determines to be attractively priced and have sustainable competitive advantages. MVAL was launched on Mar 26, 2024 and is issued by VanEck.
